# Prompt Suite 2.7.0

Prompt 2.7.0 adds the MCQ answer-position integrity overlay on top of the frozen Prompt 2.4.0 baseline, frozen Prompt 2.5.0 grounding overlay, and frozen Prompt 2.6.0 workload overlay.

This version introduces answer-position distribution rules (no streaks >= 4, no concentration > 60%, no 100% concentration for N >= 4) and targeted option-reordering repair mechanics. Schema remains 2.3.0.
